newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Electricity projects costing about 1.67 billion riyals are under implementation in the western province, official says.
- Car rental business in Saudi Arabia's eastern province facing slump, with many companies cutting back their fleet and in some cases reducing office staff.
- A mini-Disneyland style project planned in Riyadh.
- Some 61 shops were closed in Jeddah for violating hygiene rules.
- Saudi Arabia signs 12 contracts to build schools at a cost of 35 million riyals.
- Health minister signs a 46 million riyal contract with a local firm to provide food for a medical complex in Riyadh.
